title: Sumbangan Dana Pendidikan Kerajaan Negeri Perlis
deadline_note:
Open.
Applications are valid for 1 year starting from the official date your study offer letter is issued.
additional_information:
Published funding type:
One-off financial assistance.
Non-repayable education contribution.
Open to Muslim and non-Muslim students.
Not a scholarship or education loan.
application_method:
Application Method (Offline)
1. Download the form. Obtain the official application form: https://www.perlis.gov.my/phocadownload/borang/BKP%20Sumbangan%20Dana%20Pendidikan%20Dis%202021.pdf
2. Submit the application. Send the completed form along with certified copies of supporting documents directly to the Management Services Division, Perlis State Secretary's Office (Bahagian Khidmat Pengurusan, Pejabat Setiausaha Kerajaan Negeri Perlis).
source: User-supplied application form, deadline window and offline application instructions, 19 November 2026. No absolute deadline was supplied.
